task.question: What technology was used to determine the offside decision for the disallowed Croatia goal in the Portugal vs Croatia round of 16 match?
task.evidence: Joško Gvardiol slid in to finish towards the net but the goal was eventually ruled out. Igor Matanović had got a slight touch on the ball with his head after a cross, as indicated by Snickometer technology; the ball then dropped to Mario Pašalić, who was in an offside position before the goal was scored despite the ball having come off a Portuguese defender beforehand.
